articles.title: U.S. military removes bombers from U.K. base targeted in suspected terror plot - The Washington Post
articles.description: Royal Air Force Fairford has been used by the U.S. for long-range bombing missions in its war against Iran.
articles.content:
The U.S. military has removed all of its bombers from Royal Air Force Fairford, a base that authorities in the United Kingdom called the target of a suspected terror plot.
